comments.author: @UnseenOutlands
comments.text: This documentary raises a question that goes far beyond Greenland: how can a small population protect its own interests when much larger powers see its homeland as strategically important? What practical steps could help Greenlanders have the strongest possible voice in decisions about mining, military cooperation, and future development?
